settings.heading: Built for the compatible 12V vehicle.
settings.body: The documented fit reference is up to 6.0L gasoline or 3.0L diesel. A full charge can provide up to 25 starts using a standard 1.5L sedan as the reference; real results vary with battery health, temperature and engine condition.

settings.body: Follow the smart-clamp indicators before starting. The protection system includes reverse polarity, short circuit, over-voltage, over-current, overheat and over-discharge safeguards. Below 10.5V ±0.3V, the clamp does not output. See the FAQ before using it with a very low battery.

settings.heading: See the connection, signal the situation.
settings.body: The emergency light offers steady, flashing and SOS modes. Use it to see the connection and improve roadside visibility, and follow the manual for the controls and operating limits.

settings.heading: One small kit for routine and unexpected stops.
settings.body: Keep the U23 accessible for commutes, weekend trips and the moments a vehicle needs a little backup. Store it dry, inspect the clamp before each use and recharge after use.

settings.question: Which vehicles is U23 designed to support?
settings.answer: U23 is for compatible 12V vehicles, with a stated reference of up to 6.0L gasoline or 3.0L diesel engines. Confirm the vehicle, battery condition and manual before use.

settings.question: What do the current and start figures mean?
settings.answer: U23 has a documented 700A starting current, 1,500A peak current, 8,000mAh rated capacity and 29.6Wh rated energy. Up to 25 starts is based on a standard 1.5L sedan reference; results vary with vehicle and battery condition.

settings.question: How do 10 safety protections and 6-in-1 protection relate?
settings.answer: The smart-clamp system is described as having 10 total safety protections. The original feature graphic highlights six core protections—reverse polarity, short circuit, over-voltage, over-current, overheat and over-discharge—within that broader protection system.

settings.question: Can U23 charge a phone or small device?
settings.answer: Yes. The USB-A output is specified at 5V / 2.4A for everyday device charging. Recharge the U23 itself through its Type-C 5V / 2A input.

settings.question: What light modes does U23 have?
settings.answer: Steady, flashing and SOS modes are available. Follow the model manual for controls and operating limits.

settings.question: Can I use U23 in rain or rinse it clean?
settings.answer: No. U23 is not waterproof. Keep the unit, clamp and ports dry; do not submerge or rinse the product.

settings.question: What if my car battery is completely flat?
settings.answer:
The smart clamp checks the vehicle battery before it sends power. If it reads below our protective threshold — 10.5V ±0.3V as specified for this clamp — the clamp will not output: you will see the red light and hear the buzzer instead of a steady green light. That is the protection working, not a fault. Charge the battery first, or connect another vehicle for a few minutes to lift the voltage; U23 then works normally.

We deliberately did not add a Boost or Force Start button. Overriding this protection also disables reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection, and forcing sustained current past the clamp rating can heat the jaws enough to weld them to the battery terminal.

settings.question: What does the 5-year warranty cover?
settings.answer: Five years from the delivery date, against manufacturing defects and failure under normal use. If it fails, email info@suntneew.com with your order number and we will repair or replace it. See the full warranty terms.
